# jdilig.me

> Portfolio and resume of John Dilig, a Senior Front-End Developer in Redondo Beach, CA, working in React, TypeScript and Next.js with 18+ years of experience building production web apps in media, sports, streaming and SaaS. Open to full-time front-end roles; remote preferred.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.jdilig.me/): introduction, projects and resume summary
- [Projects](https://www.jdilig.me/projects): side projects, browser games and client work
- [UX](https://www.jdilig.me/ux): UX case studies, from problem and people to shipped, accessible code
- [Ember UI case study](https://www.jdilig.me/ux/design-system): an accessible React design system with tokens, eight components and docs ([Storybook](https://ember-ui-storybook.vercel.app), [code](https://github.com/balbonits/ember-ui))
- [Resume](https://www.jdilig.me/resume): experience, skills and education
- [Resume PDF](https://www.jdilig.me/Reuel_John_Dilig_Resume.pdf): full resume as a PDF
- [Contact](https://www.jdilig.me/contact): how to reach John
